shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents/skills/gravity-ui | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && ls -la && git ls-files
cat package.json src/*.tsx index.html tsconfig.json; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; grep -n -i -E "chart" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -40

npm install @gravity-ui/charts 2>&1 | tail -15; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json | grep -E '"version"|peerDep' -A6 | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist 2>/dev/null

npm install @gravity-ui/charts@^1.73.0 2>&1 | tail -5; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh charts Chart ChartData LineSeries 2>&1 | head -60
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh charts Chart ChartData LineSeries 2>&1 | head -60; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md | head -80
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs && sed -n 80,200p INDEX.md; ls -R; cat guides/theming.md | head -150
sed -n 150,260p guides/theming.md; cat guides/colors.md | head -120; sed -n 1,120p guides/series-types/line.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm && grep -rln "useTheme\|g-color-" . | head; grep -rn "DEFAULT_PALETTE\|getDefaultColors" --include=*.js . | head -8; sed -n 1,80p ../docs/guides/axes/axis-types.md | grep -n -i -A6 datetime | head -40

cat core/constants/palette.js; grep -rn "theme\|Theme" --include=*.js . | grep -v "^.*//" | head -15; grep -n "title\|colors\|legend\|tooltip" types/chart/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls types 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n -i -C3 "theme" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -120; grep -n -E "useTheme|useThemeValue|useThemeType|scoped|system" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -20; grep -rn "export.*useTheme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm && sed -n 1,80p components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls types/chart; grep -n "title\|legend\|tooltip\|colors\|xAxis\|yAxis" types/chart/chart.d.ts 2>/dev/null types/index.d.ts | head -20

f=$(grep -rl "interface ChartData" types | head -1); echo $f; grep -n -A40 "interface ChartData" $f | head -50; grep -rn -A8 "interface ChartTitle\b\|interface ChartTitle " types | head -12; grep -rn "dateFormat\|type?: ChartAxisType" types/chart/axis.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls types

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types && ls chart; grep -n -A30 "interface ChartData" chart-ui.d.ts index.d.ts chart/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -45; grep -n -B2 -A12 "interface ChartTitle\b\|interface ChartTitle {" chart/*.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "type?\|dateFormat\|title?" chart/axis.d.ts | head
